Name: AutomatePipes for Automate
Author: mrhacwer
Description:
[b]AutomatePipes[/b] is an addon for [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url][/b] that adds new paths without changing the old ones, they look like pipes on the ground.

[size=3]This mod requires [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/url].

[quote][b][u]﻿Ignore this part if you are downloading this mod for the first time or making a new save with this mod.[/u][/b]﻿
[size=4][color=Red][b]Warning before making a bug report if you are updating your mod to the 0.0.5 this version change the texture index.
[/b][/color][/size][size=3]You need to convert to the new textures.
It's [b]easy[/b] anything you already placed on the [b]ground[/b] is [b]already updated[/b].
Anything on inventory you can [b]open the inventory[/b], [b]hover on the bugged item[/b] [b]with the mouse[/b] and hold [b]Shift + Right Mouse Button[/b] to update to the new texture index.
[/size][b][u]That all![/u][/b][/quote]

Picture of the new Pipes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Me14eSp.png[/img]

In order to get the mod to work, you need to edit the [b]"Automate" "config" file.[/b]
[code]﻿Example:
{
  "Enabled": true,
  "AutomationInterval": 60,
  "Controls": {
    "ToggleOverlay": "U"
  },
  "ConnectorNames": [
    "Workbench",
    "Copper Pipe", //This line.
    "Iron Pipe", //And this line two.
    "Gold Pipe" //This is the last line XD.
  ],
  "JunimoHutBehaviorForGems": "AutoDetect",
  "JunimoHutBehaviorForFertilizer": "AutoDetect",
  "JunimoHutBehaviorForSeeds": "AutoDetect",
  "WarnForMissingBridgeMod": true,
  "MachineOverrides": {},
  "MinMinutesForFairyDust": 20
}
[/code]
Or if you're lazy you can download a [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21653?tab=files&file_id=89014]Optional File[/url][/b] and put inside [b]Automate mod folder[/b] to work properly with my pipes.

To buy the new pipe recipes, go to the [b][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Dwarf]Dwarf Store[/url][/b].

New Paths Names:

Copper Pipe: ID 960
Iron Pipe: ID 961
﻿Gold Pipe: ID 962
